name: Potion of Growth

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: The Enlarge part of Enlarge/Reduce for 1d4 hours (no Concentration).
text: For 1d4 hours after drinking, you gain the enlarge half of the Enlarge/Reduce spell with no Concentration needed: you grow by one size category, make Strength checks and Strength saving throws with Advantage, and your weapon hits deal 1d4 extra damage. A bead of red in the potion swells until it tints the whole liquid, then shrinks back again.
